title: RobotDx page speed (the data-ui page, web/dx/)

producer.name: RobotDx tools/bench_robotdx.py (bench/robotdx_driver.js in headless Chrome; bench/robotdx_stub.py for rates no fixture reaches)

gates.title: Every phase healthy: no page error, no phase that failed
gates.description: Every phase (the fixture host, each sweep point, the heap run) loads the page and measures with no uncaught exception and no console error. Pass/fail, never averaged.

legend.hollow: noisy machine (load or slow calibration): read with care

kpis.title: Cold load to the tree drawn (p95)
kpis.description: Navigation start to the first moment the entity tree has its rows drawn (an in-page 10 ms timer started before any of the page's code), in a new browser context, on the fixture host (F1). 95th percentile of the cold loads.
kpis.formula: p95 over cold loads of (tree drawn - navigation start)

kpis.title: Ingest to pixel (p95)
kpis.description: A samples batch's stamp to the first plot drawn at its newest sample. The headline is the stub's 6,000 samples/s into 6 plots, stamped at the host's emit (the stub's wall clock, the browser's too); slices: every sweep point, and the fixture host stamped at the adapter's receive (its replay clock is not the browser's; its own ~1 s change ticks are not in it). labels.stamp says which.
kpis.formula: p95 over batches of (first following plot draw with t >= the batch's newest sample - the batch's stamp)

kpis.title: Frame time while streaming (p95)
kpis.description: The interval between animation frames while the stub streams N samples/s into M live plot panels (5 keys each), after a 3 s warm-up. Headline: 6,000 samples/s into 6 plots; slices: 600 x 2, 6,000 x 6, 24,000 x 12. 16.7 ms is 60 frames a second.
kpis.formula: p95 over requestAnimationFrame intervals while streaming

kpis.title: JS heap at the retention cap
kpis.description: The page's JS heap after a forced GC once the live store has streamed into its byte cap: --long runs 10 minutes at the page's 256 MB cap; a default run uses a 64 MB cap for 90 s and says so in labels.window. Diagnostic: the cap is the budget, the heap should sit near it, not past it.

kpis.title: Scrub to every panel drawn (p95)
kpis.description: clock.seek(t) inside the entity's State on Explore (the fixture's joint, seven live panels), to the last panel's first draw at t. 30 seeks. A panel's later draws at the same t (a new version arriving) are not counted.
kpis.formula: p95 over seeks of (max over panels of the first draw at t - the seek)

kpis.title: Back to live (p95)
kpis.description: After a 2 s pause 5 s behind, clock.goLive() to the last panel's first following draw at the newest data, on Explore. 10 times.
kpis.formula: p95 over go-lives of (max over panels of the first following draw - goLive)

kpis.title: Idle traffic
kpis.description: Every byte the page receives from /api/ (streams included: CDP Network.dataReceived) over 30 s on Explore with nothing selected, on the fixture host (F1 replays every record each ~2 s, so most tree rows change every tick; a real rig sends far less).
